questions.subject: CHEMISTRY
questions.topicTitle: 5.3 The Mole Concept and Molar Mass
questions.prompt: How many total atoms are present in 0.75 moles of sulfur dioxide gas (SO₂)? (Avogadro's constant = 6.022 × 10²³ particles/mol)
questions.correctAnswer: 1.35 × 10²⁴ atoms
questions.explanation: Each molecule of SO₂ has 3 atoms (1 sulfur + 2 oxygen). Total atoms = 0.75 mol × (6.022 × 10²³ molecules/mol) × 3 atoms/molecule = 1.355 × 10²⁴ atoms.

questions.topicTitle: 5.3 The Mole Concept and Molar Mass
questions.prompt: What is the mass percent of nitrogen in ammonium nitrate (NH₄NO₃)? (Molar mass of NH₄NO₃ = 80.04 g/mol; N = 14.01 g/mol)
questions.explanation: There are 2 nitrogen atoms in NH₄NO₃. Total mass of N = 2 × 14.01 = 28.02 g/mol. Mass % = (28.02 / 80.04) × 100% = 35.007% ≈ 35.0%.

questions.topicTitle: 5.3 The Mole Concept and Molar Mass
questions.prompt: In the reaction 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O, if 4.0 moles of H₂ react with 3.0 moles of O₂, what is the limiting reactant and theoretical moles of H₂O formed?
options: H₂ is limiting; 4.0 moles H₂O formed
O₂ is limiting; 6.0 moles H₂O formed
H₂ is limiting; 2.0 moles H₂O formed
O₂ is limiting; 3.0 moles H₂O formed
questions.correctAnswer: H₂ is limiting; 4.0 moles H₂O formed
questions.explanation: 2 moles of H₂ require 1 mole of O₂. Thus, 4.0 moles of H₂ require 2.0 moles of O₂. Since 3.0 moles of O₂ are present, H₂ is completely consumed first (limiting reactant). 4.0 moles H₂ produces 4.0 moles H₂O.

questions.prompt: What volume in liters is occupied by 64.0 grams of methane (CH₄) gas at Standard Temperature and Pressure (STP)? (Molar volume at STP = 22.4 L/mol; C = 12.01, H = 1.008)

questions.explanation:
Step 1: Convert mass of paracetamol to grams and calculate moles:
$$\text{Mass} = 120\text{ mg} = 0.120\text{ g}$$
$$\text{Moles} = \frac{0.120\text{ g}}{151.16\text{ g/mol}} = 0.00079386\text{ mol}$$

Step 2: Convert volume to liters:
$$\text{Volume} = 5.0\text{ mL} = 0.0050\text{ L}$$

Step 3: Calculate Molarity ($M$):
$$M = \frac{\text{Moles}}{\text{Volume (L)}} = \frac{0.00079386\text{ mol}}{0.0050\text{ L}} = 0.15877\text{ M} \approx 0.159\text{ M}$$
